en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a panoramic view of a hillside village with low stone or brick houses scattered across the slope. In the foreground there is a large gathering or procession of villagers, many wearing traditional dress and head coverings, some with animals, moving along a path. Mountains and rolling hills form the background. Printed French captions appear below the image, and a website watermark (elia.org.gr) is visible over the lower right of the photograph.
